recent_posts.title: OpenVid: The Open-Source Studio to Create Cinematic Demos in Your Browser
recent_posts.summary: OpenVid is a browser-based, open-source video editor designed for developers and makers who need to create professional product demos quickly. It requires no installation and has no complex timeline, running entirely in the browser for fast, cinematic results.

recent_posts.title: PostPeer: manage social media APIs in one place
recent_posts.summary: PostPeer is a unified API platform that abstracts away the complexity of integrating with multiple social media platforms including Twitter/X, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Threads, and Pinterest. It provides a single interface for posting, scheduling, and content management, handling OAuth flows and platform-specific quirks so developers don't have to. It also supports no-code automation via Zapier and Make, targeting SaaS founders, developers building marketing tools, and no-code builders.

recent_posts.title: LocalChat.app: Private AI chat that runs fully on your Mac
recent_posts.summary: LocalChat.app is a macOS application that runs open-source AI models locally on Apple Silicon, with no cloud servers, subscriptions, or accounts required. It supports 300+ models in GGUF format from providers like Meta, Mistral, Google, and DeepSeek. Key features include document chat via drag-and-drop, vision support, offline functionality, encrypted local storage, and zero telemetry. It targets professionals handling sensitive data such as lawyers, developers, and healthcare workers. The app is a one-time purchase rather than a subscription service.

recent_posts.title: AI Facebook Ad Generator: Create On-Brand Ads Faster
recent_posts.summary: Venngage's AI Facebook Ad Generator lets marketers and businesses create on-brand Facebook ads by entering a short product or campaign description. The tool generates ready-to-edit ad concepts with suggested visuals, headlines, and layouts sized for Facebook placements. Key features include Auto Branding for consistent colors/fonts/logos, editable templates, AI-assisted messaging suggestions, and accessibility-friendly design options. It targets small teams, non-designers, and agencies looking to reduce manual formatting time and produce multiple ad variations faster.

recent_posts.title: Redii: Global Retirement Benefits Without Borders
recent_posts.summary: Redii provides a unified global retirement benefits platform that enables companies to offer retirement plans to employees across 150+ countries without setting up separate local schemes. The solution integrates with existing payroll and HR systems, handles automated administration and compliance, and includes dedicated implementation support. It addresses the complexity of managing cross-border benefits for distributed teams while helping companies improve talent attraction and retention.

recent_posts.title: Say About Us: simple way to show real customer trust
recent_posts.summary: Say About Us is a testimonial management tool that simplifies collecting and displaying customer feedback. It offers a no-login link for customers to submit video or text testimonials, imports reviews from platforms like LinkedIn and G2, and provides embeddable widgets and Wall of Love pages. Priced at $5/month with no limits on testimonials, it targets solo founders and small teams looking for straightforward social proof solutions.

recent_posts.title: GenDesigns: mobile app mockups without design skills
recent_posts.summary: GenDesigns is an AI-powered tool that generates mobile app mockups from plain English descriptions, targeting non-designers like founders, product managers, and developers. It creates platform-native screens following iOS and Android guidelines with consistent theming across flows. The tool exports production-ready HTML with Tailwind CSS or high-resolution images, removing design bottlenecks in early product development without requiring Figma expertise or hiring designers.

recent_posts.title: AI Instagram Post Generator: create better visuals, faster
recent_posts.summary: Venngage's AI Instagram Post Generator creates Instagram-ready visuals from text prompts without design skills. It offers pre-sized templates, AI-generated on-image text, Brand Kit integration for consistent branding, drag-and-drop editing, and accessibility checks. Users input a prompt, receive a designed post with suggested text, customize as needed, and export. The tool eliminates the blank canvas problem, maintains visual consistency, and enables regular posting for marketers, creators, and small businesses.

recent_posts.title: Word Cloud Generator : Turn Text into Visual Insights
recent_posts.summary: A Chrome extension that converts text into word clouds, visualizing word frequency through size-based representation. Users can paste text, upload files, or select webpage content to generate customizable visual maps instantly. The tool offers real-time editing, multiple export formats, and an AI-driven layout engine. Designed for students, teachers, researchers, and professionals who need to quickly identify patterns and themes in text without external uploads or complex software.

recent_posts.title: dnAI : One Clear Source of Truth for Your Brand
recent_posts.summary: dnAI is a brand management platform that centralizes brand standards, monitors AI-driven search visibility, and maintains messaging consistency across marketing and sales teams. It tracks how brands appear in ChatGPT, Claude, and Google AI responses, provides competitive intelligence filtered through marketing frameworks, and ensures content alignment through automated workflows while keeping human judgment central to decision-making.
